description:
Create an instant voice clone from one or more local audio samples.

WHEN TO USE:
- Clone a speaker from short audio samples the user provides
- Add a custom voice to the account for generate_speech or speech_to_speech

EXAMPLE: {"name": "My Clone", "files": ["/path/to/sample.mp3"], "description": "Meeting voice"}

RELATED TOOLS:
- delete_voice: remove a cloned voice when no longer needed (required for live-test cleanup)
- generate_speech: synthesize speech with the new voice_id
- list_voices: confirm the clone appears on the account

RETURNS: voice_id and requires_verification flag. When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies to each files[] path. Standalone clients require each file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or os.tmpdir()).

COST: Uses a voice slot; may consume credits depending on plan.

description.description: Optional voice description stored on the account.

files.description: One or more absolute audio file paths. When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies to each path; standalone clients require each file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or os.tmpdir()).

labels.description: Optional key/value labels for the voice.

name.description: Display name for the cloned voice.

remove_background_noise.description: When true, reduce background noise in samples. Default: false.

name: clone_voice
